thread:
sanjay: Heads up — Dedicated dashboard for cluster prod-eu-west shows 0 GPUs (all node/GPU panels empty) after we swapped annotations on the nodepool. Customer reported degraded throughput.
claire: which customer/ticket?
sanjay: Ticket RED-4582. They saw capacity drop ~09:12 UTC when ops changed nodepool annotation from 'gpu-type=nvidia-a100' to 'gpu=accel-a100' during a rolling rename.
claire: steps to repro?
sanjay: Repro steps I ran:
1) kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=gpu-pool -o wide
2) kubectl annotate nodepool gpu=accel-a100 --overwrite
3) wait ~30s
Observed: Console shows 0 nodes in Dedicated > Inventory; API /v1/internal/dedicated/inventory returns empty list for that cluster.

kubectl output:
```
NAME                         STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION
gpu-node-1                   Ready    <none>   12d   v1.26.3
gpu-node-2                   Ready    <none>   12d   v1.26.3
```

curl to internal API:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/v1/dedicated/prod-eu-west/inventory
[]
```

maya: that's worrying — sounds like the inventory sync job lost those nodes due to annotation filter mismatch. tom any ideas where the filter lives?
tom: it's in infra/metrics-inventory service — it maps node labels -> pool ids using the annotation key set in config: NODEPOOL_ANNOT_KEY
eli: did config get updated? maybe rollout changed the key to 'gpu' but the service still reads 'gpu-type'
claire: can we verify the deployment config?
:infra-bot: deployment metrics-inventory v2.3.1 rolled out at 09:10 UTC
sanjay: yes infra-bot shows a rollout at 09:10, ops changed annotation at 09:11 — timing matches.
maya: temporary mitigation: revert annotation to previous key and trigger inventory sync job (POST /internal/ops/inventory/refresh) — will that restore panels?
tom: should; inventory will repopulate once nodes match filter. Also can patch metrics-inventory config to accept both keys as fallback.
eli: I'll spin a quick canary with fallback and manual refresh.
claire: assign to oncall for follow-up and a postmortem. sanjay can you add repro logs to RED-4582 and ping the customer that we're investigating? :thumbsup:
sanjay: done, added logs and timeline. pinged customer with ETA 2h.
maya: after fix, we should add alert if inventory count diverges >20% from k8s node count for a cluster.
tom: filing infra ticket INFRA-1227 for config fallback + alerting.
claire: good. thanks all, keep updates here.
